title: Baker Hill Golf Club
specs: Golf course designed by Rees Jones, known as 'The Open Doctor'.

Appropriate golf attire required; men must tuck in shirts; no athletic shorts, exercise clothing, bathing suits, blue jeans, tee shirts, tank tops, or cargo pants; women's leggings allowed if covered by a skirt; caps must have brims forward and removed in dining/lounge areas.
Driver's license required to use a golf cart or tempo walk.
gap: Price for green fees or memberships not stated
blurb: Baker Hill Golf Club offers a golf course designed by Rees Jones that incorporates the natural contours of the land with attention to environmental protection. The club provides a distinctive golfing experience while caring for natural resources. Guests must follow specific dress codes and golf etiquette rules.
extraNote: Players may not bring their own alcoholic beverages to the course. · Maximum of two riders per cart; remove key when leaving a young child or unlicensed driver in a golf cart. · Check in at the Pro Shop when arriving at the Club.
